news.summary: A bipartisan group of lawmakers is urging the FDA to plug a loophole used to import knockoff retatrutide, an investigational obesity drug made by Eli Lilly.

news.summary: How do voters feel about trans students participating in school sports teams? Or abortion access? The U.S. is about to find out.

news.summary: Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and Beth Israel Lahey Health are starting work on a $1.68 billion cancer hospital in Boston, marking a new phase in their competition with Mass General Brigham.

news.summary: Melania Trump said a new research and policy initiative will set “a new standard for women’s health.”

news.title: Hackensack Meridian Health signs definitive agreement to acquire Hunterdon Health, commits $230M
news.summary: The announcement did not outline a potential timeline for the merger, which would add a nineteenth hospital to New Jersey's largest health system.

news.summary: A policy change directs healthcare organizations seeking lighter repercussions from potentially criminal fraud activity to disclose to the DOJ alone, rather than separately between law enforcement and Department of Health and Human Services Office of Inspector General.

news.title: Judi Health launching employer Medicare Part D plan with a focus on transparency
news.summary: Judi Health is launching a new Part D plan that aims to lean on its tech stack to drive transparency and outcomes.

news.title: Bullying among nurses is a 'pervasive' threat to patients, clinicians—here's what employers can do
news.summary: The American Nurses Association's latest position statement on incivility and bullying includes recommendations for nurses and healthcare employers alike, including an argument against zero-tolerance policies in favor of "restorative and tiered" approaches.

news.title: Commercial plans' mental health provider directories routinely inaccurate, secret shopper study finds
news.summary: Fewer than a quarter of secret shopper phone calls to a listed mental health provider ended in a scheduled appointment, often due to inaccurate contact information or other issues with a plan's directory.

news.title: OpenEvidence, Doximity reach settlement in contentious AI legal battle
news.summary: Healthcare AI startups OpenEvidence and Doximity settled a contentious legal fight over allegations of corporate espionage and cyberattacks, alongside counterclaims of defamation and misinformation.

news.title: Trump EO creates new NIH division, White House task force centered on women’s health
news.summary: The goals of the new bodies are to address women’s health research gaps to improve health outcomes across the lifespan.

news.title: Redesigning prior authorization around the patient
news.summary: Abarca Health explores how shared standards, transparency and outcome-focused measures can reduce prior authorization friction.

news.title: The case for rethinking how ambulatory practices handle cybersecurity
news.summary: Healthcare is among the most targeted sectors for cybercriminals, and it's easy to see why.

news.title: Lycia aims for $228M IPO to generate data on food allergy rival to Xolair
news.summary: Lycia Therapeutics is banking on a $227.8 million IPO as the biotech seeks to finance its pipeline of protein degraders for autoimmune, inflammatory and allergic diseases.

news.title: Rapport's phase 2 bipolar win strikes chord with analysts despite falling short of original ambition
news.summary: Rapport Therapeutics’ phase 2 bipolar mania study has hit its primary endpoint, furthering the biotech’s efforts to make RAP-219 a multiindication blockbuster. However, the effect size fell short of the level targeted by Rapport and analysts ahead of the readout.

news.title: Hengrui has become the go-to source of China biopharma innovation. What’s its secret?
news.summary: Amid the Chinese biotech licensing boom, Hengrui Pharmaceuticals stands out from the crowd. The Jiangsu-based biopharma landed one of the largest licensing deals ever by a Chinese company courtesy of a head-turning $15.2 billion biobucks pact with Bristol Myers Squibb in May. At the same time, Hengrui has been quietly pioneering the transition from a straight-up licensor of innovation drugs to a co-developer that’s establishing NewCo entities with its Western partners.

news.title: Industry at a ‘turning point’ with growth dominated by commercial leaders: EY report
news.summary: A new report has found that in 2025 through the first half of 2026, innovation increased dealmaking and R&D investment, AI heavily influenced the future of value creation, and that industry growth continued to expand into alternative care settings.

news.title: Israeli biotech’s inhaled exosome therapy reduces respiratory failure in phase 2 study
news.summary: Nano24’s inhaled exosome therapy reduced respiratory failure in patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), hitting the main goal of a phase 2b study.

news.title: Pfizer makes ‘business decision’ to end phase 2 trial of autoimmune drug as program’s future uncertain
news.summary: Pfizer has called time on a phase 2 trial of its CXCR5 antibody in an autoimmune blood disorder, with the company tight-lipped on whether this marks the end of the road for the asset.

news.title: AstraZeneca taps Oracle to help improve recruitment for clinical trials
news.summary: AstraZeneca has turned to data giant Oracle as the U.K.-based Big Pharma works on one of the eternal problems of drug development—improving patient recruitment.

news.title: Ambrose Healthcare inks $181M deal for former Pfizer target AM-Pharma
news.summary: Ambrose Healthcare has bought AM-Pharma for up to 161 million euros, inking a cut-price deal for a biotech once courted by Pfizer.

news.summary: Life sciences-focused investment firm TCGX will use a special purpose acquisition company to take migraine-minded TriGemX Bio public.

news.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

news.summary: The collaboration is another in a series of partnerships Lilly has accumulated in both drug delivery and AI-based technologies.

news.title: Gilead ‘sitting on a foundational asset’ after oral UC drug's phase 2 win
news.summary: Gilead touted a mid-stage win for its inflammatory bowel disease pill after the treatment delivered clinical improvements in patients with ulcerative colitis.

papers.title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
papers.summary: Decision models support routing, guardrails, and output verification in LLM systems. However, item accuracy alone cannot establish whether models make correct decisions across controlled variations or assign reliable confidence to their predictions. We introduce DecisionPivot, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 48 tasks and 40,033 items across seven decision roles. Its core track contains 7,800 items from 13 generated task families, organized into contrast groups with computed answers verified by independently implemented solvers. papers.title: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
papers.summary: Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows. Existing multimodal approaches combine structured health record data, chest x-rays, and clinical text, but primarily focus on modality fusion or missing-modality compensation, with limited attention to temporal trajectories over an admission.
